content.short: Anemoy is a regulated onchain asset manager from the Centrifuge ecosystem that runs tokenized Treasury and S&P 500 funds.
content.description: Anemoy was set up to bring Centrifuge's real-world asset work into regulated fund products. Investors subscribe with stablecoins and receive fund tokens, with holdings data published onchain. Its products include a tokenized fund holding US Treasuries and a tokenized S&P 500 tracker created together with Janus Henderson. The funds are issued on Ethereum, Base and Celo, which lets them plug into DeFi lending and treasury tools. Its funds now include a AAA CLO fund alongside the Treasury and S&P 500 products, and in 2026 New York Life Investment Management used Anemoy and Centrifuge to launch a tokenized US high yield bond strategy.
